title: SCOPE: Score-Isolated Agentic Optimization for Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.15043v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators for planning and embodied decision making, yet improving them at inference time introduces a subtle evaluation problem: prompts, samplers, verifiers, and selectors may evolve together, making it difficult to attribute gains or prevent held-out feedback from shaping the final policy. We introduce \scope (\emph{\scopefullname}), a framework for auditable inference-time adaptation of frozen video world models. \scope represents external controls as a typed state, updates this state only through bounded changes supported by development evidence, and freezes the resulting policy before held-out evaluation. On Physics-IQ benchmark, \scope improves over the exact frozen base by $+14.24$ (95\% CI $[+8.10,+21.23]$). Controlled ablations further identify gains from scene specification, sampling, and learned selection, while the margin over the strongest matched agentic baseline remains unresol

translated_title: SCOPE：面向视频世界模型的分数隔离智能体优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15043v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视频世界模型越来越多地被用作规划和具身决策的模拟器，但在推理时对其进行改进会引入一个微妙的评估问题：提示、采样器、验证器和选择器可能共同演化，使得难以归因性能提升或防止留出反馈塑造最终策略。我们引入了SCOPE（全称：分数隔离智能体优化），一个用于冻结视频世界模型的可审计推理时适应的框架。SCOPE将外部控制表示为类型化状态，仅通过基于开发证据的有界更改来更新此状态，并在留出评估前冻结最终策略。在Physics-IQ基准测试中，SCOPE比精确冻结的基线提升了+14.24（95%置信区间[+8.10,+21.23]）。受控消融进一步识别了来自场景规范、采样和学习选择的增益，而相对于最强匹配智能体基线的优势仍然无法解决。
tldr: SCOPE提出了一种可审计的推理时适应框架，通过类型化状态和有界更新优化冻结视频世界模型，在Physics-IQ基准上显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: SCOPE proposes an auditable inference-time adaptation framework that optimizes frozen video world models via typed states and bounded updates, achieving significant gains on the Physics-IQ benchmark.
